resources.string: Tap to view the original and on-device translation.
On-device translation may be inaccurate. Follow the original alert and official guidance.
A translation model is not ready. Prepare it on Wi-Fi.
Could not identify a supported source language.
Could not complete this action. The original is preserved. Retry when ready.
These are capture and source reception times. The disaster occurrence time is not verified.
Official severity: unavailable. Classification varies by country and source.
Source codes: category %1$d · priority %2$d · CMAS %3$s · ETWS %4$s. These are not a universal severity scale.

Android 13+ may block access for directly installed APKs. Open App info → More → Allow restricted settings, then enable each access separately. If the menu is missing, open the Android app list below, select CodeClear, and open More there. Menus vary; device administrators may prevent changes.
Translate on this device with ML Kit. Chinese script conversion supports simplified and traditional output.

Prepare the source and target language models using Wi-Fi. Downloads use data and storage and may continue under Android after leaving this screen or turning translation off. Alert text is not uploaded. Translation resumes only while local translation is enabled.
Originals and translations stay in private device storage until you delete them. No account, synchronization, server translation, or alert uploads. App backup and transfer are disabled.

CodeClear works on Android 11+ phones and tablets. Direct emergency-alert reception requires cellular hardware. Wi-Fi-only devices can still show saved records and translations. Complete capture depends on the installed alert receiver and firmware; tested profiles do not establish worldwide support. Capture starts after the first unlock following reboot.

Android notification access can expose notifications from other apps. CodeClear reads only reviewed installed system emergency-receiver sources and saves individual complete alert text in private local history for on-device translation. It does not upload alert text or open screens automatically. Turn capture off here or revoke access in Android Settings at any time.

CodeClear uses accessibility to read the single message field, title, and pending count in reviewed system emergency-alert dialogs. Other screens and history rows are excluded. It does not perform gestures or dismiss warnings. Originals stay in private history for local translation. This is not a disability assistance tool. Turn capture off here or revoke access in Android Settings at any time.

Enable automatic on-device translation of captured alerts. Language models require a separate Wi-Fi download approval. No alert text is sent to a translation server. Turning this off stops new translations while preserving your history.
Access is enabled; service is reconnecting. Recheck in Android Settings if this continues.
Capture and translation are paused to avoid losing records. Check available storage and retry. Check capture permissions again afterward.
Your system emergency-alert app receives cellular broadcasts. Keep its warnings enabled. CodeClear supplements the original warning. Wi-Fi-only hardware cannot receive cellular emergency broadcasts.

In Settings, review notification and accessibility disclosures, then enable each access in Android Settings. Notifications can expose individual text; accessibility reads the visible system alert dialog. If only a summary is available, open the original alert from Home. Hidden pending messages are not automatically dismissed to read them.

Enable local translation and choose a target language. Approve model preparation on Wi-Fi when prompted. Ready models work offline. Tap a result notification to open its original and translation; search saved records in History. Delete records whenever you choose.
This device has no cellular receiver for emergency alerts sent by cell towers. A Wi-Fi connection alone cannot receive these broadcasts. You can still view saved records and translations.
Cellular radio capability could not be verified. Current Wi-Fi use, SIM absence, and mobile data settings do not determine hardware capability.
No reviewed system alert receiver was found. Automatic capture is unavailable for this source profile.
Allow notification or accessibility access in Settings to capture alerts. Both routes improve coverage.
Capture is enabled for exposed messages from reviewed system sources. Keep the original emergency-alert app enabled.
The latest source observation did not expose a verified complete individual body. The saved alert below may be older. Open the original system alert to check it.
Pending alerts reported by the source: %1$d. Only exposed individual bodies can be captured; open the original to check the others.
Newly captured alerts appear here. An empty screen does not establish whether an emergency alert was issued or received.
Preparing models or waiting for Wi-Fi. Android may continue the download in the background.
This record was deleted or is unavailable.
This removes the selected originals and translations from this app. It does not delete or dismiss system emergency alerts. This cannot be undone.
Open Android Settings → Apps → CodeClear and select the relevant access setting.
System translation is unavailable. Choose ML Kit in Settings or check the system translation service.
The selected engine does not support this language pair. Choose another engine or target language.
Prepare language models in the system translation settings, then retry.
System translation settings are unavailable or busy. Try again or choose ML Kit.
The source language matches the target. Chinese script conversion may apply.
No result for this engine and language yet. Tap Retry to translate this record.
Use ready on-device language pairs from the installed system service. Chinese script conversion supports simplified and traditional output.

Use the installed Android system service for captured alert text through the public on-device translation API. Only language pairs reported as ready receive text. CodeClear does not upload alert text to an app translation server. Review the service privacy information and prepare models in its own settings. Turning this off stops new work and preserves history.
No compatible system translation service is available. Choose ML Kit or review the system service settings.
For %1$s: ready pairs %2$d; pairs needing preparation %3$d. Source-language support is checked for each alert.
The system service does not report a language pair for %1$s. Choose another target language or ML Kit.
Changing engines keeps the current translation on/off choice. Existing results retain their producing engine.
Get notified when a translation is ready. Alert text is kept out of notifications.
Could not open the link. Check your browser settings and try again.
The original language could not be identified. Keep the original and try again.

Freshly captured originals are available to nearby users. Received messages have unverified origin and authenticity. They are automatically saved in private history until you delete them and are never forwarded again.

Bluetooth sharing can continue in the background with a persistent status notification. Stop it here or from the notification. No GPS coordinates or server are used. Android may stop the app; reopen it to resume.
No recent messages. You can find previously received messages in History.
Could not save. Check sharing access and available storage.
BLE is unavailable on this device
Looking for nearby devices · receive only
Exchange stopped. Check access and try again.
Android 11 requires location permission and system location for Bluetooth discovery. This app does not collect GPS coordinates.
Experimental features may change. Nearby sharing stays off until you allow it.
Labs is unlocked. Open it from Settings.
Server translation is not connected. Translation still runs on this device. The planned response includes the issuing authority and how it was identified. No alert text is sent to a server.
Could not save a received message. Nearby history is limited to 1,000 records. Check storage or delete unwanted nearby records, then try saving again. Existing history is preserved.
Receiving with Bluetooth in the background. Tap to open the app or stop sharing.
Background reception is not running. Keep the app open and check access.
On Android 11, background Bluetooth discovery needs location access set to Allow all the time in app settings. You can keep using sharing while the app is visible without that extra access.
